## Why This Is Asked
Tests real-time collaboration with multiple users and network faults; ensures your E2E strategy covers synchronization, latency, and failure modes.

## Key Concepts
- Real-time collaboration and event propagation
- Deterministic testing via mocks and controlled timing
- Test data isolation and multi-context orchestration
- Offline scenarios and reconnection convergence
